remarks: Some of what you need to know: Located in West Norwalk this 5271 sq ft home situated on gorgeous level 1+ acre corner lot. 13 rooms, 5-6 bedrooms and 4 full baths. Primary bedroom suite with sitting room, huge bathroom, jacuzzi tub and 2 walk in closets. French doors lead to private balcony. Kitchen with dining area and sliders to large for grilling/dining. Media room with 12-seat home theatre and surround sound. Family room, living room, formal dining room located on the 1st floor. Office/game room located on upper level. Heated Gunite pool is like new. Pool house, stone patio, and irrigation system. Sprayed in foam insulation, On-demand hot water heaters, 7 zone propane gas heat, Heated 3 car garage. Easy access to New Canaan & Merritt Parkway. Excellent condition. Take a look and decide for yourself how much you love this home.
